title: Levies
summary: Addresses when to recognise a liability to pay a levy imposed by government, clarifying that the obligating event is the activity described in the legislation that triggers payment.

related.relationship: Supplies the underlying recognition and measurement framework IFRIC 21 applies specifically to levies

related.title: Income Taxes
related.relationship: Governs income taxes, explicitly excluded from IFRIC 21's scope

related.title: Liabilities Arising from Participating in a Specific Market – Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment
related.relationship: The earlier interpretation whose obligating-event reasoning IFRIC 21 generalises to all levies

related.title: Interim Financial Reporting
related.relationship: Governs interim reporting, into which IFRIC 21's obligating-event timing is applied consistently
